title: Keto Cheeseburger Casserole Skillet
conventions: buy strings are cook measures (what goes in the pot), grams derived FROM the printed measure via db\densities.json so the two agree by construction; quantities quantized to house quarters, drift from the exact 3.5x scale noted per line where it exceeds 5%.
ruled_substitutions: '1 pound ground beef or ground turkey' is booked as BEEF (the cheeseburger title protein), 80/20 class (ground-beef-8020, 7 of 7 stores, cheapest Sam's $4.77/lb) with the NEW USDA 80/20 DB row - the same generic-term ruling as low-carb-taco-cabbage-beef-skillet in this batch, and again load-bearing for the floor: the house 93/7 row computes this dish to 394.6 cal, 5 cal UNDER the 400 floor. The source's own internally inconsistent label most closely matches 90/10 beef, a class no board commodity carries; 80/20 is the nearest carried class in the direction that keeps the dish honest about what the buy string tells the reader to buy. The turkey alternative is recorded, unpriced.

'1/2 cup chicken or beef broth' is booked as CHICKEN broth (listed first by the source; chicken-broth 7 of 7, cheapest Aldi $0.0373/floz). Beef-broth alternative recorded, unpriced; macro difference is under 2 cal per serving.

macro_cross_check.verdict: EXPLAINED - the protein gap crosses 15% so the main protein line was re-examined per rule 6, and the portion survives: it is weight-anchored by the source (1 lb / 4 servings = 113.4 g raw), no each-weight assumption exists. The source's label is internally INCONSISTENT (4x25 + 9x27 + 4x5.3 = 364 cal against their stated 423, a 59 cal hole), so exact agreement is unavailable by construction. Their figures reproduce almost perfectly with 90/10 beef (recomputed 423.7 cal on our own rows) - a class no board commodity carries; our disclosed 80/20 ruling adds ~88 cal and ~11 g fat over that 90/10 basis, which is the entire calorie gap. Against a corrected 90/10-basis source protein (32.7 g), our 29.5 g reads -9.8%, inside tolerance. Carbs agree at 5.4 vs 5.3.
macro_cross_check.band_check: computed 511.5 cal in [400, 650] PASS; carbs 5.4 g <= 35 PASS. With the 93/7 row instead the dish computes 394.6 cal and FAILS the floor by 5 cal - the 80/20 ruling is load-bearing, see ruled_substitutions. No optional lines.

loud_flags: The beef fat class decides this recipe's floor: 80/20 -> 511.5 PASS, 93/7 -> 394.6 FAIL (by 5 cal). Source's own (inconsistent) label sits between at ~90/10, a class the board does not carry. The 80/20 ruling is disclosed in ruled_substitutions; if the house prefers lean beef here, this recipe is a marginal floor-fail and should be re-based or dropped, not fudged.
Source macro set is internally inconsistent by 59 cal (documented in the cross-check); treat their published card as approximate.
board_defects_observed: Same generic-term hole as the taco skillet: bare 'ground beef' resolves to no commodity despite two fully priced ground-beef ids on the board.
